item.alone_journey.crystalline_heart.too: A heart condensed from crystal, the crystals on it still shifting in color.
Regenerates 1 shield every 10 seconds after taking damage
Higher armor and armor toughness increase shield capacity and regen speed
item.alone_journey.bleedingshield.toolti: A shield forged from congealed blood, the blood still seeks to erode its wielder.
Every 2 armor points or 1 health point sacrificed converts to 1 armor toughness
item.alone_journey.adaptive_flesh.toolti: A squirming piece of living tissue that seems to learn alongside your pain.
Each hit of a damage type grants 1 layer of adaptation (15% per layer, max 5); taking a different damage type decays all existing layers by 1
item.alone_journey.engineer_goggles.tool: Precision engineering goggles that see through machinery.
When worn, point the crosshair at a machine / network node to show its info and power range to the left of the crosshair
item.alone_journey.night_contract.toolti: A pact signed in blood; moonlight is its gift, sunlight its curse.
In sunlight (daytime, unobstructed sky): health cannot regenerate, and you are afflicted with Wither
At night (indoors or outdoors): restores 1 health every 4 seconds and grants Night Vision
Can sleep during the day; sleeping in daylight skips straight to nightfall
Brighter moon phases grant higher bonuses: new moon +10%, up to full moon +50% movement speed and crit damage
Current moon: %1$s -- +%2$s movement speed and crit damage
item.alone_journey.parryshield.tooltip.d: Raise this shield at the moment an enemy strike lands for a perfect defense.
item.alone_journey.parryshield.tooltip.p: Block within 1s of raising: full immunity, reflects 250% damage and weakens the attacker for 3s (1s parry cooldown)
item.alone_journey.parryshield.tooltip.b: Held up longer: absorbs 80% of the damage
item.alone_journey.painstrike_hammer.too: A heavy war hammer; swinging it demands a toll in rhythm.
Hits inflict Vulnerability for 10s; repeat hits extend 5s and add +1 level. Each triggered hit deals +50% damage and removes one level
item.alone_journey.chainsword.tooltip.de: A mysterious imperial weapon from 39 millennia in the future, relying on serrated teeth to cut through foes.
item.alone_journey.chainsword.tooltip.la: Hits inflict and stack Laceration: +4 levels per normal attack, +2 per Overclock slash (doubled with High-Speed Slash enchant), duration fixed at 2s, then settles damage equal to the level and halves it. Hits also stack Trauma: +2 layers per normal attack, +1 per Overclock slash; each layer increases the target's damage taken by 1% and deals 0.2 magic damage every 0.5s (max 100 layers). Hold to enter Overclock mode; 15s cooldown after it ends (duration, cooldown and Trauma values configurable).
item.alone_journey.powersword.tooltip.de: A mysterious imperial weapon from 39 millennia in the future, driven by highly compressed energy; its strikes cut far beyond ordinary alloys.
item.alone_journey.powersword.tooltip.pi: Armor Penetration: main hits ignore armor toughness; against targets with armor above 8, deals 0.3 extra damage per armor point over, and 0.5 per toughness point above 6 (max 10 combined); this bonus damage ignores armor and armor toughness
item.alone_journey.powersword.tooltip.ov: Overclock: right-click to activate for 13s (5 durability cost); grants Resistance II for 5s on activation; while active, +6 attack damage, hits deal 3 extra fire damage and ignite the target for 4s, and 80% of damage dealt heals the wielder; 15s cooldown afterwards (duration and cooldown configurable)
block.alone_journey.operating_table.tool: Used for surgery to enhance your body's abilities.
Right-click with empty hand to view current surgery levels
Per level: +5% Attack Damage, +15% Attack Speed
Per level: +10% Movement Speed, +15% Jump Height
block.alone_journey.void_miner.tooltip.d: Automatic miner, based on a 7x7 area (XZ plane) centered on the block center, extending 5 blocks upward
block.alone_journey.void_miner.tooltip.c: Mining cycle: 40 minutes, each ore block can be mined 3 times before disappearing
block.alone_journey.void_miner.tooltip.p: Each mining produces base output x2, export using funnel
block.alone_journey.fuel_generator.toolt: Consumes fuel to produce FE energy
block.alone_journey.power_core.tooltip.d: Creates, controls and manages a power network
block.alone_journey.power_core.tooltip.c: Network storage: 1,000,000 FE x (core level + 1), level 0-5
block.alone_journey.power_core.tooltip.l: Right-click to open network screen, use the Power Link button inside to link nodes
A component used to upgrade the Power Core (to level %s).
Consume instantly in the Power Core upgrade slot at core level %s, upgrading to level %s (max 5), increasing network storage
The 5x5 area around it is a power zone
Right-click to open network screen, use the Link Wire button inside (distance <= 80 blocks)
A high-power node extending the network coverage
The 11x11 area around it is a power zone
Right-click to open network screen, use the Link Wire button inside (distance <= 40 blocks)
gui.alone_journey.network.throughput_hin: Click to switch: Instant / 5 min / 10 min
message.alone_journey.power_link.start: §ePower link started, open the target Signal Pole / Power Core screen and press the link button to connect (distance <= %s, press the start button again to cancel)
message.alone_journey.power_link.fail_in: §cLink failed: target is not a Signal Pole / Power Core
